name: Tokimeki Memorial Drama Series Vol. 3: Tabidachi no Uta
original_name: ときめきメモリアルドラマシリーズ Vol.3 旅立ちの詩
source:
Tokimeki Memorial Drama Series vol.3 Tabidachi no Uta ("Poem of Journeys") features both Shiori Fujisaki and Miharu Tatebayashi sharing a similar story about the player running a marathon just before graduation that branches off into different directions depending on which girl you choose to pursue. 

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/T/SLPM-86224.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
《心跳回忆Drama Series》第3作《启程之歌》（“旅途之歌”）讲述玩家在毕业前参加马拉松的故事。根据你选择追求的女孩，故事将分为不同方向，藤崎诗织与馆林见晴各自拥有一条路线。

[来源：[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/T/SLPM-86224.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
